integrity: The general statement is proved symbolically from the path-boundary equations. Finite-field computations for widths 3 through 24 are used only as replay checks, not as proof of the universal quantifier.
scientific_limitations: The theorem classifies the degree-four path-chain module, not the degree-four path homology group.
No minimality claim is made for the family or its coefficient-sensitive members.
The originality assessment is limited to the inspected literature and indexed searches.
title: A parity law for cyclic Fu–Ivanov path chains
